description: This is a JUnit test class for the PublisherService in a book management application. It tests various methods such as findById, save, findAll, delete, deleteAll, and count, using Mockito to mock dependencies.

classes.name: PublisherServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for PublisherService, testing CRUD operations and exception handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock PublisherRepository and the PublisherService before each test.

methods.name: findById_throwsNullPointerException_ifIdIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that findById throws NullPointerException when null is passed.

methods.name: canFindByNonNullId
methods.description: Tests that findById correctly calls the repository with a valid ID.

methods.name: save_throwsNullPointerException_ifPublisherIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that save throws NullPointerException when null is passed.

methods.name: canSaveValidPublisher
methods.description: Tests that a valid Publisher object is saved via the repository.

methods.name: canFindAll
methods.description: Verifies that findAll calls the repository's findAll method.

methods.name: delete_throwsNullPointerException_ifPublisherIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that delete throws NullPointerException when null is passed.

methods.name: canDeleteValidPublisher
methods.description: Tests that a Publisher object is deleted via the repository.

methods.name: canDeleteAll
methods.description: Verifies that deleteAll calls the repository's deleteAll method.
